inputs.text: You won't believe what they're pulling now—earlier this month an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law by claiming limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice pushed this line, saying the law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” This isn't any authentic religious position. It's all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions twisting religion into a weapon to shield the killing of babies and push their control agenda. They're straight-up inverting the truth, hiding behind so-called freedom while stamping out real protections for life. Don't trust the surface story for a second.
